    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">（原创）[C#]【开源】一分钟使用 PicoServer 打造日志服务器</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="一前言">一、前言</h1>
<p>近期有项目要快速开发一些原型类的WebAPI，从桔子雨大佬那了解到了PicoServer（原名：MicroServer），经过一段时间的使用，发现很契合我的需求。正好手头上有一个测试时用PicoServer开发的日志服务器，便开源出来，一是很轻量、开箱即用；二是也做为一篇示例教程，好让不了解的人快速上手。</p>
<p>开源地址：<a href="https://gitee.com/lesliexin/lesliexin.simplelogservice" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/lesliexin/lesliexin.simplelogservice</a></p>
<p><strong>相信看完的你，一定会有所收获！</strong></p>
<p>本文地址：<a href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lesliexin/p/19475073" target="_blank">https://www.cnblogs.com/lesliexin/p/19475073</a></p>
<h1 id="二picoserver简介">二、PicoServer简介</h1>
<p>官网如下：<a href="https://picoserver.cn/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://picoserver.cn/</a></p>
<p>简介（来源：官网）：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113085807455-360298463.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="三开发日志服务器">三、开发日志服务器</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>注：为了保持经量且拥有基本的设置界面，便使用WinForm进行开发，读者可根据实际需要，改成WPF或服务等形式。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="一引用nuget包">（一）引用NuGet包</h2>
<p>Nuget包地址：<a href="https://www.nuget.org/packages/PicoServer/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.nuget.org/packages/PicoServer/</a></p>
<p>在VS里可直接搜索安装：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113085938211-1696933414.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>除此之外，我们还要引用log4net、Newtonsoft.Json包：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090230225-1585436812.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="二设计界面">（二）设计界面</h2>
<p>我们增加端口、密码等设置信息：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090432075-1322414843.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="三使用picoserver">（三）使用PicoServer</h2>
<p>我们看官网文档会发现，PicoServer使用起来非常简单，实例化-&gt;添加路由-&gt;启动，即可。</p>
<h3 id="1实例化">1，实例化</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090635558-2021932898.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="2添加路由">2，添加路由</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090717596-1968371051.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090734806-164738256.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>其中写日志是使用log4net：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090809905-1722583017.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h3 id="3启动">3，启动</h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113090843914-296467892.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>到此，我们的日志服务器就开发完毕了，是不是意外的简单？</p>
<h1 id="四运行效果">四、运行效果</h1>
<h2 id="1启动时">1，启动时</h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113091216215-848980367.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="2启动">2，启动</h2>
<p>我们选择输出日志流，这样能在界面上看到日志信息，但生产环境部署时不要开启。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113091320780-1669331081.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2 id="3测试接口">3，测试接口</h2>
<p>我们使用VS Code的Thunder Client插件来测试接口。</p>
<p>先是Err日志：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113091433058-265671302.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113091437518-1159961259.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>我们打开日志文件：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113093047466-756020055.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>再是Info日志：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113091508754-1912796046.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113091514960-1864083724.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>

<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1686429/202601/1686429-20260113093053618-806618979.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h1 id="五结语">五、结语</h1>
<p>在此之前写轻量级的WebApi接口，一般是用Asp.Net Core，很好，唯一不爽的是需要部署，如果自部署又会附带诸多dll，非常不便。</p>
<p>在很多场景，只是为了实现某几个特定业务而写接口，这种时候我的需求就是怎么快怎么来、怎么简单怎么来。</p>
<p>而PicoServer，一个50KB的DLL，就很好的契合我的需求，真不错。</p>
<p>-[END]-</p>
